endorsements.quote: In stewardship, this means AI can suggest antibiotic regimens, but final judgment must remain with clinicians who weigh contextual factors such as patient preferences and comorbidities.
Ensure explainability of AI outputs to clinicians and patients.
Provide continuous training for healthcare professionals on ethical use of AI.
Address bias and inclusivity by using diverse datasets and auditing models regularly.

unlisted_practices: Engage patients and communities in AI design and deployment.
Ensure cultural appropriateness by tailoring AI applications to local contexts.

screen.reason: This is a perspective/letter discussing ethical frameworks and best practices for deploying AI responsibly in infectious diagnostic decision-making and therapeutic stewardship.
